spec.description:
Homelab Overview.
Benötigt: Node Exporter auf allen Hosts, Pi-hole Exporter, smartctl Exporter auf Mnemosyne und Daidalos.

spec.expr: (node_filesystem_size_bytes{instance=~"$mnemosyne_host", mountpoint="/mnt/vault", fstype!="tmpfs"} - node_filesystem_avail_bytes{instance=~"$mnemosyne_host", mountpoint="/mnt/vault", fstype!="tmpfs"}) / node_filesystem_size_bytes{instance=~"$mnemosyne_host", mountpoint="/mnt/vault", fstype!="tmpfs"} * 100

(node_filesystem_size_bytes{instance=~"$mnemosyne_host", mountpoint="/mnt/backup", fstype!="tmpfs"} - node_filesystem_avail_bytes{instance=~"$mnemosyne_host", mountpoint="/mnt/backup", fstype!="tmpfs"}) / node_filesystem_size_bytes{instance=~"$mnemosyne_host", mountpoint="/mnt/backup", fstype!="tmpfs"} * 100

(node_filesystem_size_bytes{instance=~"$mnemosyne_host", mountpoint="/", fstype!="tmpfs"} - node_filesystem_avail_bytes{instance=~"$mnemosyne_host", mountpoint="/", fstype!="tmpfs"}) / node_filesystem_size_bytes{instance=~"$mnemosyne_host", mountpoint="/", fstype!="tmpfs"} * 100

(node_filesystem_size_bytes{instance="boreas", mountpoint="/", fstype!~"tmpfs|overlay"} - node_filesystem_avail_bytes{instance="boreas", mountpoint="/", fstype!~"tmpfs|overlay"}) / node_filesystem_size_bytes{instance="boreas", mountpoint="/", fstype!~"tmpfs|overlay"} * 100

(node_filesystem_size_bytes{instance="hephaestus", mountpoint="/", fstype!~"tmpfs|overlay"} - node_filesystem_avail_bytes{instance="hephaestus", mountpoint="/", fstype!~"tmpfs|overlay"}) / node_filesystem_size_bytes{instance="hephaestus", mountpoint="/", fstype!~"tmpfs|overlay"} * 100

spec.title: 📊 Backup Service Status
spec.description: Per-service backup status: 0 = OK, 1 = FAIL, 2 = SKIP (no changes detected)

spec.title: 📦 Archive Sizes by Service
spec.description: Size of each backup archive. Thresholds: yellow = 1 GB, orange = 10 GB, red = 30 GB.

spec.title: ⏱️ Step Duration by Service
spec.description: Backup step runtime per service. Thresholds: yellow = 60s, orange = 5min, red = 10min.

spec.title: 🔍 Verify Result
spec.description: Result of the last verify-backup.sh run. Shows number of failed checks (0 = all passed).

spec.title: ⊘ Skipped
spec.description: Number of services skipped because no files changed since last backup.

spec.title: 💿 Backup Disk Free
spec.description: Free space on /mnt/backup as reported by backup-services.sh at run time.

spec.title: 📈 Archive Size Over Time
spec.description: Archive size per service over time. A rising nextcloud line is the early warning for a full backup disk.

spec.expr: (node_filesystem_size_bytes{instance="zephyros", mountpoint="/", fstype!~"tmpfs|overlay"} - node_filesystem_avail_bytes{instance="zephyros", mountpoint="/", fstype!~"tmpfs|overlay"}) / node_filesystem_size_bytes{instance="zephyros", mountpoint="/", fstype!~"tmpfs|overlay"} * 100

spec.title: 🩺 SMART Health
spec.description: Overall SMART self-assessment. FAILED means the drive predicts its own imminent failure -- replace immediately.

spec.expr: smartctl_device_smart_status * on(instance, device) group_left(model_name, serial_number) smartctl_device

spec.title: 🔍 Monitored Drives
spec.description: Number of drives returning SMART data. Expected: 1. The two WD consumer USB enclosures (Game Drive, My Passport) do not pass SAT through and cannot be monitored -- see SmartctlCoverageChanged alert.

spec.title: ⚠️ Reallocated Sectors
spec.description: Sectors remapped to spare area. The earliest reliable degradation signal -- any value above zero means the drive has started to fail.

spec.title: ⏳ Pending Sectors
spec.description: Unreadable sectors awaiting remap. Often precedes reallocation; data in these sectors may already be lost.

spec.title: ❌ Offline Uncorrectable
spec.description: Sectors that could not be corrected during offline scans.

spec.title: 🕒 Power-On Years
spec.description: Cumulative runtime. Not an alert condition -- a planning figure. This drive was acquired used and already carries significant hours.

spec.title: 🌡️ Drive Temperature
spec.description: Thresholds are provisional -- adjust once a baseline has been observed over a full seasonal cycle. Source: smartctl_device_temperature - covers ATA and NVMe drives (the former Temperature_Celsius attribute query missed NVMe).

spec.title: 📉 Sector Health History
spec.description: All three counters must stay flat at zero. Any upward step is a hardware event, never noise.

spec.title: 🔌 SATA CRC Errors
spec.description: Link-layer errors, not media errors. A non-zero historic count is normal on used drives; only an increase matters.

spec.title: 🧯 smartctl Failures
spec.description: Lower four bits of the smartctl exit code: command failed, open failed, checksum error, SMART FAILING. Log-entry bits are masked out.

spec.expr: (node_filesystem_size_bytes{instance="daidalos", mountpoint="/", fstype!~"tmpfs|overlay"} - node_filesystem_avail_bytes{instance="daidalos", mountpoint="/", fstype!~"tmpfs|overlay"}) / node_filesystem_size_bytes{instance="daidalos", mountpoint="/", fstype!~"tmpfs|overlay"} * 100

(node_filesystem_size_bytes{instance=~"$astraeusnx_host", mountpoint="/", fstype!~"tmpfs|overlay"} - node_filesystem_avail_bytes{instance=~"$astraeusnx_host", mountpoint="/", fstype!~"tmpfs|overlay"}) / node_filesystem_size_bytes{instance=~"$astraeusnx_host", mountpoint="/", fstype!~"tmpfs|overlay"} * 100

(node_filesystem_size_bytes{instance=~"$proteus_host", mountpoint="/", fstype!~"tmpfs|overlay"} - node_filesystem_avail_bytes{instance=~"$proteus_host", mountpoint="/", fstype!~"tmpfs|overlay"}) / node_filesystem_size_bytes{instance=~"$proteus_host", mountpoint="/", fstype!~"tmpfs|overlay"} * 100

(node_filesystem_size_bytes{instance=~"$mnemosyne_host", mountpoint="/mnt/codex", fstype!="tmpfs"} - node_filesystem_avail_bytes{instance=~"$mnemosyne_host", mountpoint="/mnt/codex", fstype!="tmpfs"}) / node_filesystem_size_bytes{instance=~"$mnemosyne_host", mountpoint="/mnt/codex", fstype!="tmpfs"} * 100

spec.title: 🧪 NVMe Wear
spec.description: Percentage of the vendor-rated write endurance already consumed. Can exceed 100 % - the drive keeps working, but is past its rating. Alert NvmeWearHigh fires at 80 %.

spec.expr: smartctl_device_percentage_used * on(instance, device) group_left(model_name, serial_number) smartctl_device

spec.title: 🛟 NVMe Available Spare
spec.description: Remaining reserve blocks. Starts at 100 % and stays there on a healthy drive for years - low is bad. Alert NvmeSpareDegraded fires below 80 %, the vendor threshold (critical warning bit) sits at 1 %.

spec.expr: smartctl_device_available_spare * on(instance, device) group_left(model_name, serial_number) smartctl_device

spec.title: ❌ NVMe Media Errors
spec.description: Unrecovered data integrity errors - the NVMe equivalent of Offline Uncorrectable. Any value above zero means data could not be read back correctly.

spec.expr: smartctl_device_media_errors * on(instance, device) group_left(model_name, serial_number) smartctl_device

spec.title: 🚨 NVMe Critical Warning
spec.description: Bitmask from the drive itself: 1 spare below threshold, 2 temperature, 4 reliability degraded, 8 read-only mode, 16 volatile backup failed. Any bit set is serious.

spec.expr: smartctl_device_critical_warning * on(instance, device) group_left(model_name, serial_number) smartctl_device

spec.title: 📝 NVMe Error Log Entries
spec.description: Lifetime count of the controller's error log. Not every entry means data loss, but on a healthy drive this stays flat - alert NvmeErrorLogGrowing watches the 24h increase.

spec.expr: smartctl_device_num_err_log_entries * on(instance, device) group_left(model_name, serial_number) smartctl_device

spec.title: 💾 NVMe Data Written
spec.description: Total host writes over the drive's lifetime. Compare against the vendor TBW rating. Baseline: ~312 GB from burn-in (fio) and the initial clone, not regular operation.

spec.expr: smartctl_device_bytes_written * on(instance, device) group_left(model_name, serial_number) smartctl_device

spec.title: 📈 NVMe Writes (rolling 24h)
spec.description: Bytes written in the preceding 24 hours. bytes_written is exported as a gauge, so delta() is used instead of increase(). Answers how much the system disk actually writes per day - the basis for a realistic lifetime estimate.

spec.expr: delta(smartctl_device_bytes_written[24h]) * on(instance, device) group_left(model_name, serial_number) smartctl_device

spec.title: 01_01_Homelab_Overview
